findings.title: Where kids' events are most often free
findings.text: Across all 42 metros, 27.5% of the 7,411 dated events in the next 30 days are free. The highest free shares are in [Raleigh](https://grassyknees.com/raleigh) (63% of 101), [Denver](https://grassyknees.com/denver) (58% of 394) and [Cleveland](https://grassyknees.com/cleveland) (52% of 87); the lowest are in [Nashville](https://grassyknees.com/nashville) (10% of 93), [Providence](https://grassyknees.com/providence) (14% of 108) and [Houston](https://grassyknees.com/houston) (14% of 197). (Metros with at least 50 upcoming events.)

findings.title: What a paid kids' event costs
findings.text: The typical metro's median paid ticket is $22 (median of 42 metro medians; usually one child's ticket as the organizer lists it). The most expensive are [San Francisco](https://grassyknees.com/san-francisco) ($30), [Dallas](https://grassyknees.com/dallas-fort-worth) ($29) and [San Antonio](https://grassyknees.com/san-antonio) ($29); the cheapest are [Raleigh](https://grassyknees.com/raleigh) ($11.50), [Detroit](https://grassyknees.com/detroit) ($12) and [Washington](https://grassyknees.com/washington-dc) ($12).

findings.title: What kind of activities there are
findings.text: Community is the largest category: 31.1% of 15,513 current listings, ahead of Arts & crafts (25.7%) and Sports & play (14.8%). It leads (or ties) in 30 of 42 metros; the exceptions are [New York](https://grassyknees.com/new-york) (Arts & crafts), [Los Angeles](https://grassyknees.com/los-angeles) (Arts & crafts), [Washington](https://grassyknees.com/washington-dc) (Arts & crafts), [Miami](https://grassyknees.com/miami) (Arts & crafts), [Boston](https://grassyknees.com/boston) (Arts & crafts), [San Francisco](https://grassyknees.com/san-francisco) (Arts & crafts), [Seattle](https://grassyknees.com/seattle) (Arts & crafts), [San Antonio](https://grassyknees.com/san-antonio) (Arts & crafts), [Austin](https://grassyknees.com/austin) (Arts & crafts), [Las Vegas](https://grassyknees.com/las-vegas) (Arts & crafts), [Providence](https://grassyknees.com/providence) (Arts & crafts) and [Milwaukee](https://grassyknees.com/milwaukee) (Outdoors).

findings.title: Free-heavy metros are not necessarily cheaper
findings.text: Across the 42 metros with at least 50 upcoming events, there is no rank correlation between a metro's free-event share and its median paid ticket (Spearman's rho = -0.07). A metro with many free events does not reliably have cheaper paid ones.

findings.title: Read the counts as catalog coverage, not per-capita supply
findings.text: Current listings per 100,000 residents range from [Denver](https://grassyknees.com/denver) (26.0) down to [New York](https://grassyknees.com/new-york) (2.9), with a median of 11.9. Large metros are not proportionally larger in the catalog, so compare shares and medians across metros, not raw counts.
